latest.notes:
Song separation now holds cover versions apart.

• Songs recorded by two artists — "Drift Away" by Dobie Gray and by Uncle Kracker, "Brown Eyed Girl" by Van Morrison and by Jimmy Buffett — were not being held apart. Seven simulated days over the station's library put fourteen such pairs inside the three-hour song rule, one of them 36 minutes. Now none.
• Two records with the same title count as one song. Where that's a coincidence rather than a cover — Fleetwood Mac's "Dreams" and The Cranberries' — list the title under Settings ▸ Separations ▸ "Different Songs, Same Name" and they stop blocking each other. The same artist's own versions are still held apart either way.
• The top-of-hour filler and the log generator now apply the same rule.

Worth doing once after updating: open Settings ▸ Separations and add the titles your library shares by coincidence, so those songs return to full rotation.
